objectives.en: Name the parts of a leaf and types of venation

body.en: A typical leaf has a leaf base, a petiole and a lamina; the leaf base may have two small stipules. In legumes the leaf base may be swollen into a pulvinus, and in monocots it forms a sheath around the stem. The arrangement of veins is venation: reticulate (a network) in dicots and parallel in most monocots.
body.kn: ಎಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆಬುಡ, ತೊಟ್ಟು ಮತ್ತು ಪತ್ರಫಲಕ. ದ್ವಿದಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಲ ನಾಳವಿನ್ಯಾಸ, ಏಕದಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ನಾಳವಿನ್ಯಾಸ. ದ್ವಿದಳ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆಬುಡ ಉಬ್ಬಿ ಪಲ್ವೈನಸ್ ಆಗಿದೆ.

title.en: Simple and compound leaves, and phyllotaxy

body.en: A leaf is simple if its lamina is entire or the cuts do not reach the midrib, and compound if the cuts reach the midrib and divide it into leaflets. A bud is present in the axil of the petiole of both, but never in the axils of leaflets. In pinnately compound leaves like neem, leaflets sit on a common axis, the rachis; in palmately compound leaves like silk cotton, leaflets attach at the tip of the petiole. Phyllotaxy is alternate in China rose and mustard, opposite in Calotropis and guava, and whorled in Alstonia.
body.kn: ಕಡಿತಗಳು ಮಧ್ಯನಾಳವನ್ನು ತಲುಪಿದರೆ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಎಲೆ. ಮೊಗ್ಗು ತೊಟ್ಟಿನ ಕಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ಎಲೆಚಿಕ್ಕೆಗಳ ಕಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಬೇವು ಗರಿರೂಪಿ, ಬೂರುಗ ಹಸ್ತರೂಪಿ. ಎಲೆ ಜೋಡಣೆ: ಪರ್ಯಾಯ, ಅಭಿಮುಖ, ಆವರ್ತ.

points.en: Bud in axil of petiole, not of leaflets

body.en: Leaves are modified into tendrils for climbing in peas and into spines for defence in cacti. Onion and garlic have fleshy leaves that store food. In Australian Acacia the leaves are small and short-lived, and the petioles expand, turn green and make food. In insectivorous plants such as the pitcher plant and the Venus fly-trap, leaves trap insects.
body.kn: ಬಟಾಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆ ಸುರುಳಿತಂತು, ಕಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳ್ಳು. ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ, ಬೆಳ್ಳುಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಹಾರ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ತಿರುಳಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳು. ಹೂಜಿ ಸಸ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ವೀನಸ್ ಫ್ಲೈ ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A twig has five leaf-like blades on a common axis, with a bud only at the base of that axis and none at the base of each blade. Is it one compound leaf or a branch with five simple leaves?

steps.en: Buds occur in the axils of leaves, so a bud marks the base of a whole leaf.
Here there is a bud only at the base of the common axis, not at each blade.
So the blades are leaflets on a rachis: it is one pinnately compound leaf, like neem.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A twig has five leaf-like blades on a common axis, with a bud only at the base of that axis and none at the base of each blade. Is it one compound leaf or a branch with five simple leaves?
Team quiz. Talk it over in your team and lock in one answer.
